# statusdrift_incidents (Data Source)

Fetches incidents, optionally filtered by status, type, priority, or monitor.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `monitor_id` (Number) Filter by monitor ID.
- `priority` (String) Filter by incident priority: low, medium, high, or critical.
- `status` (String) Filter by incident status: open or resolved.
- `type` (String) Filter by incident type: manual or system.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.
- `incidents` (Attributes List) List of incidents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--incidents))

<a id="nestedatt--incidents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `incidents`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the incident was created.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the incident.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The ID of the monitor this incident belongs to.
- `priority` (String) The priority of the incident.
- `resolved` (Boolean) Whether the incident is resolved.
